decisions.reason: Maintainer-confirmed correction in issue #2. This game's original character has no applicable SRW MX/Akurasu entry; update dialogue, glossary, UI, music/movie names and artwork consistently.

English localization requested in issue #4 and authorized by the user's request to fix all open issues. Translate the call, UI/trait labels and movie captions; preserve original spoken audio and subtitle timing. This supersedes the previous keep-the-call translator guidance; no Akurasu term is overridden.

Issue #4 requests a natural English address. Pops preserves the Riders' familiar paternal nickname; the fuller Oyassan Tachibana becomes Mr. Tachibana. Preserve a stammer as P-Pops. No applicable Akurasu entry is overridden.
Explicit user correction on 2026-10-09; use consistently in all English text and glossary aliases.
